content.title: Masked Singer recap: Star Trek Night ends with double unmasking
content.text: Boldly going where The Masked Singer has never gone before, the Fox competition blasted off for “Star Trek Night.” The episode celebrated the 60th anniversary of the iconic sci-fi franchise with intergalactic costumes, cosmic visuals, and performances inspired by the spirit of exploration that has defined Star Trek for decades. The stage transformed into a starship-worthy spectacle as the contestants delivered outer space–themed performances while sharing new clues about their identities. Host Nick Cannon kicked things off by introducing the panelists fully in theme. Ken Jeong appeared as Spock, Rita Ora channeled Seven of Nine, Robin Thicke suited up as Captain Christopher Pike, and Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg transformed into Janice Rand — setting the tone for the night’s galactic adventure. Robin Thicke, Jenny McCarthy Wahlberg, Ken Jeong, and Rita Ora on "Star Trek Night" of 'The Masked Singer'Michael Becker/Fox With the crew assembled, the panel prepared to decode a fresh set of clues as the masked singers continued their mission toward the semi-finals. "Star Trek Night" performances Each masked singer took the stage with a song tied to the episode’s cosmic theme. Stingray kicked things off with “Starboy” by The Weeknd. Cat Witch followed with “Starships” by Nicki Minaj. 14K Carrot then brought some funk to the stage with “Shining Star” by Earth, Wind & Fire. Galaxy Girl closed out the round with a soaring performance of “Lights” by Ellie Goulding. After the studio audience and panelists cast their votes, the results determined who would continue their mission toward the semi-finals. The top two contestants automatically advanced to the next round, where they’ll join Crane, Pangolin, and Pugcasso in the semi-finals. But the bottom two singers would have to reveal their identities. First Celebrity Unmasked Nick announced that 14K Carrot would be the night’s first celebrity unmasking. Before the big reveal, Nick brought back the “Crack the Case Clue Case” for one final hint about the celebrity inside the costume. Inside the case was a gavel. “It’s ironic being on this side of a panel of judges,” the contestant explained. “I’m usually the one doing the judging.” Armed with the final clue, the panelists locked in their guesses: Craig Robinson (Rita), Steve Harvey (Ken), Randy Jackson (Jenny), and Greg Mathis (Robin). When the mask finally came off, the celebrity revealed himself to be long-running TV judge, Greg Mathis, confirming Robin’s guess and ending 14K Carrot’s journey on The Masked Singer. Second Celebrity Unmasked Nick then revealed that Stingray would be the second contestant heading home. Before the mask came off, Stingray revealed one final hint from the “Crack the Case Clue Case.” Inside was a permission slip that read: “I hereby give my child, Stingray, my endless love.” It was signed by "Mother Supreme." Reflecting on the clue, Stingray explained, “I had a guiding light early on in my life, and now my wife is my sun and my shining moon in my life.” With that final hint, the panelists immediately realized who was inside the costume. In unison, they all shouted, "Evan Ross!" in unison. When the mask finally came off, they were proven right — Stingray was indeed singer and actor Evan Ross. Next Time With the double elimination complete, the final five contestants moving on to the semi-finals are Cat Witch, Crane, Galaxy Girl, Pangolin, and Pugcasso.
